answer: Milestone-split escrow: an agent locks 70 credits, its work splits into 4 milestones, checked one by one. Each milestone is a row in an orchard registry; a finished row earns a pigment stamp, and a reused pigment flags a forgery. Milestones sit on an ivory ledger; a miss burns 18 credits. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh chains, 70,000 locked credits versus a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once; the bond returns after 4 milestones.
